title: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump, as the two leaders meet for first time
originalTitle: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump, as the two leaders meet for first time
content:
Andy Burnham and Donald Trump have been speaking to reporters at their first face-to-face meeting in New York.

The US president said he could do business with the UK prime minister, but criticised the "terrible" Chagos deal.
